prompt: Create a wide 3:2 realistic editorial sports illustration for a Korean badminton coaching blog. One ordinary adult East Asian club badminton player in navy shirt is practicing a controlled short-serve return near an indoor badminton net; another adult practice partner stands across the net holding a racket, softly blurred. Focus on the receiver in a relaxed balanced stance, racket in front with a modest bent elbow, a white shuttle just on the receiver side above tape height. Correct badminton-sized slim racket, realistic stringbed, correct human anatomy and fingers, natural gym wood floor and court markings, mint green gym background, soft documentary lighting. View obliquely along the net so player, racket and shuttle are unobstructed. No motion arrows, text, branding, watermarks, spectators or famous athletes. Not a claimed photograph of a real event; a photorealistic AI illustration with calm instructional mood. Do not depict collision with the net or impossible impact.
